statements.t: Among other developments, we announced that a Fortune 50 employer selected us to provide our integrated cardiometabolic care platform to more than 100,000 eligible employees, with commercial launch expected in the first half of 2027.

In August 2026, we announced the expansion of our provider-backed cardiometabolic platform to include women's health and sleep solutions, with revenue contributions expected to begin in the fourth quarter of 2026.
